decision.name: SEPARATE_WRITER_SERIALIZATION_FROM_READER_SNAPSHOT_ACCEPTANCE
decision.finding: Pinned two-writer regression verifies only writer-to-writer final-file coherence. A cross-file writer lock could make that test GREEN while an unsynchronized reader still observes mixed output during a three-file publication. Exact runner.py writes latest/audit/anata in three independent atomic_write_json calls; storage.py os.replace is atomic per file only. No generation manifest or production snapshot-reader contract is established by those pinned sources. Therefore writer-only GREEN must not be promoted as reader-consistency proof.
no_network_acceptance_contract: First verify unchanged 17-file baseline at exact public SHA. Materialize and hash test-only overlays; do not commit Specialist code.
Writer P0: retain conditional B wait and release A in finally, assert both completed and final three as_of_ms exactly writer B, not merely equal.

Reader diagnostic: same-clock A empty archive vs B one valid ETF BTC FLOW row, fixed T=1800000060000; preflight A/B normalized counts 0/1, coverage 0/>0 and scoring source_evidence empty/present. Do not require B directional score or known=true: a single row has insufficient trailing history.

Gate B immediately after its latest.json os.replace; record actual A/B payloads including audit, read raw three-file triplet while B is paused, prove whether mixed. Always release B in finally and bound joins; capture hashes/event order.

Acceptance after any repair must additionally exercise the actual supported production snapshot-reader protocol (or atomic generation publication) under that gate. A test-only reader adapter or writer-only lock does not prove consumer safety; raw legacy triplet remains a diagnostic until reader contract exists.

Run targeted python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_output_generation.py part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_same_clock_reader.py, then python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests. Retain overlay hashes, non-skipped counts, stdout/stderr, exit codes.

blocker.next_feasible_recovery: Authorized disposable exact-SHA checkout/test host, materialize hashed test-only overlays, execute baseline and targeted/full tests, preserve evidence. No DNS clone retry.
